title: Center-aligned row content
description: Row content aligns on the cross-axis (align-items: center) instead of the default text baseline, so the con-milla badge and the PRÓXIMO/ABORDANDO state label sit vertically centered against the headsign and eta rather than sharing their text baseline.
baseline_ref: .arrival-row (grid 1fr auto auto; align-items: baseline) and .arrival-row__destination (align-items: baseline)

changes.intent: Switch row grid alignment from baseline to center so badge/state/eta line up on the vertical center of the row rather than the headsign's text baseline.
Center the con-milla badge against the headsign instead of baseline-aligning it, matching the row-level change.
